description: x402 endpoint deep check, never pays or signs: the full /api/x402-check report plus live checks. GET url (optional method, body). Adds TLS, security headers, CORS, payTo vs the payee's own published addresses (/.well-known/x402, openapi.json, llms.txt), lookalike payTo detection, and drift between the live 402 and well-known, openapi and CDP Bazaar listings. Any HTTP answer from the target is billed; bad input, blocked hosts and timeouts are not. Price $0.03 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer

body.description: Optional JSON body (string, <=8KB) for a POST probe; implies POST

method.description: Probe method: GET (default; retries POST on 405) or POST

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the x402 endpoint to check
